job.rawJd:
Project Manager

Category: Project Management
Company: ExtensisHR

Who We Are:
ExtensisHR, one of the largest Professional Employer Organizations (PEOs) in the U.S. with client employees in all fifty states, is looking for talented people to join our team. Our HR offerings include personalized services for HR, employee benefits, payroll and taxes, employer risk, compliance, and employee management. Today, we manage over $3 billion in employment-related costs annually.

Who You Are:
The Project Manager is responsible for leading cross-functional projects that support ExtensisHR's strategic initiatives, operational improvements, and business priorities. This role partners with business stakeholders, technology teams, and vendors to plan, execute, and deliver projects that drive business value. The successful candidate will be comfortable managing multiple priorities, facilitating collaboration across teams, and ensuring projects remain on track to meet objectives.

As a member of the PMO, the Project Manager provides structure, communication, and accountability throughout the project lifecycle. This individual will manage plans, coordinate stakeholders, track risks and dependencies, facilitate issue resolution, and support business outcomes.

What You'll Do:
Project Leadership:
- Lead cross-functional projects from initiation through implementation that support business goals.
- Partner with business leaders to define project objectives, scope, timeline, success measures, and project plans.
- Translate business objectives into actionable project plans, milestones, and deliverables.
- Drive project momentum, accountability, and decision-making in evolving or ambiguous environments.
- Manage multiple high-priority initiatives while balancing competing business needs and resource constraints.

Project Execution:
- Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, RAID logs, requirements, status reporting, and project documentation.
- Identify, manage, and mitigate project risks, issues, dependencies, and resource constraints.
- Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned to business objectives.
- Manage scope changes, schedules, and stakeholder expectations throughout the project lifecycle.
- Coordinate internal teams and third-party vendors.
- Follow established PMO standards and contribute to continuous improvement.

Stakeholder and Executive Engagement:
- Build partnerships across departments and with senior leadership.
- Facilitate alignment across business, operational, and technology teams.
- Prepare and present executive-ready status updates, recommendations, risks, decisions, and action plans.
- Lead project meetings, team workshops, stakeholder discussions, and status updates.
- Escalate issues appropriately and recommend resolutions.
- Assist with project-to-operations transition planning to support ownership and adoption.

AI Utilization and Literacy:
- Use and understand AI tools and technologies to improve productivity, decision-making, and performance. Maintain awareness of emerging AI applications, apply AI tools ethically and effectively, and continue developing AI proficiency.

What You Bring:
Required Qualifications:
- 3-5+ years of project management-related experience managing cross-functional initiatives, stakeholders, risks, timelines, and project delivery.
- Proven success managing complex, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and competing priorities.
- Experience working with business leaders, project sponsors, and cross-functional stakeholders.
- Ability to take initiative, solve problems proactively, and manage projects independently.
- Strong leadership, facilitation, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level presentations and reporting.
- Experience with project management methodologies, frameworks, and reporting.
- Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and project management tools.

Preferred Qualifications:
- PMP or CAPM certification strongly preferred.
- Experience in PEO, payroll, HR outsourcing, benefits administration, professional employer services, or related industries.
- Experience leading transformation, process improvement, automation, or technology implementation initiatives.
- Experience working with CRM systems, HRIS systems, and enterprise business systems.
- Familiarity with Agile, Hybrid, and traditional project delivery methodologies.
- Experience supporting executive steering committees, PMOs, and organizational change initiatives.

The role may be performed in a hybrid or remote setting depending on business needs and employee accommodation. Occasional travel may be required. Position salary: $100,000-$115,000.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Project Manager role at ExtensisHR. I spent eight years in agency account leadership, where the work centered on project plans, budgets, timelines, status reporting, vendors, approvals, and cross-functional delivery. Since then, I have led enterprise product work and built technology workflows that make complex decisions easier to manage. I am interested in bringing that background into a dedicated PMO role.

At FCB Health, I was one of two consumer account leads on the agency's largest pharmaceutical business and managed the $20M Namenda XR direct-to-consumer launch. I also owned the broadcast workstream for three national television commercials in one year, coordinating research, regulatory review, production, talent and location logistics, and network clearances. Earlier, on the $10M NUVIGIL consumer business, I owned weekly client status and financial reporting, multichannel delivery, review-committee submissions, and annual strategic recommendations.

At Kinesso, I helped grow a distributed product design team from 2 to 30 while planning staffing, scope, resources, quality reviews, and engineering handoff across more than 20 products. I built the company's first UX research practice with checkpoints in project plans, led workshops on product discovery and ecosystem mapping, and presented recommendations to executives and clients. I also helped turn a digital audit method into a repeatable workflow with benchmarks, recommendations, and client-ready reporting.

My current work sits between business needs and implementation. At Hedgehox, I built a Scope Generator for agency finance and operations teams and helped turn brief intake, review routing, submission capture, and regulatory monitoring into working tools. Through One Block Away, I lead discovery, define the problem, build a testable POC, gather feedback, and turn the result into a clear next decision. AI is part of that work, but the point is always a better process and a useful handoff.

My titles have spanned account leadership, UX, product strategy, and implementation. The common thread is giving complicated work enough structure to move: clarify the objective, make the plan visible, keep stakeholders aligned, surface risks early, and close the loop. I would welcome a conversation about bringing that approach to ExtensisHR's PMO.
